name: Time-Series ML & Forecasting
summary: Forecasting and learning from time-ordered data with classical statistical models, feature-based machine learning and modern deep and foundation models.

topics.name: Time-series data: trend, seasonality, stationarity and autocorrelation
Forecasting workflow and baseline methods (naive, seasonal naive, drift)
Exponential smoothing (ETS) and ARIMA/SARIMA models in practice
Forecast evaluation: backtesting, rolling-origin validation, MASE and sMAPE
Feature-based ML forecasting: lags, rolling windows, gradient boosting
Hierarchical and grouped forecasting and reconciliation
Probabilistic forecasting and prediction intervals (quantile loss)
Deep learning forecasters: LSTMs, TCNs, DeepAR, N-BEATS
Transformers for time series (Temporal Fusion Transformer, PatchTST)
